name: Abijah
overview: The Scripture introduces Abijah as the son of Jeroboam who fell seriously ill, prompting Jeroboam to send his wife in disguise to the prophet Ahijah for a divine word concerning their son. Despite Ahijah's physical blindness due to age, the Lord revealed to him the true identity of Jeroboam's wife and the grave message she was to receive. This passage highlights God's sovereign knowledge and control over the circumstances surrounding Abijah's sickness and the unfolding judgment on Jeroboam's household.
